prompt:
Create a production game ALBEDO TEXTURE ATLAS, 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 exactly equal square tiles, all edge-to-edge with absolutely no gutters, labels, captions, borders or frames. The atlas itself is a perfect square high-resolution image. Orthographic flat material scans for a realistic fine-voxel cyberpunk city, physically detailed but restrained, soft microdetail with very clear material identity. Same scale of micro grains for all tiles, neutral flat even illumination, no cast shadows, no perspectives, no photographed objects or compositions. Textures should tile within their own square. Tile positions and colors must follow exactly, read from top left, row major.
Row 1: (0) weathered warm beige concrete with mineral pores and subtle hairline cracks, low contrast; (1) cool blue-gray cast concrete, subtle seams and faint rain streaks; (2) ivory ceramic facade panel texture with soft tiny chips, understated pale grouting; (3) dark charcoal machined gunmetal plates with subtle brushed metal grain and small recessed panel joints.
Row 2: (4) dark copper with reddish-brown oxidation, rubbed edges, realistic industrial patina; (5) desaturated teal-green weathered painted steel, mottled oxidized tiny chips; (6) very dark navy blue architectural glass, faint cyan reflected sheen, surface dust, no specific environment reflected and no window frame; (7) dark brown smoked architectural glass with muted amber tint, subtle reflection and dust, no window frame.
Row 3: (8) nearly black wet asphalt with visible fine aggregate and subtle uneven dark moist patches, no road paint; (9) gray rectangular sidewalk paving slabs with refined seams and slight weathering, no objects; (10) industrial yellow and black diagonal hazard stripes painted on worn metal, natural flaking wear; (11) dark weathered rooftop gravel with tiny stones evenly distributed, restrained scale.
Row 4: (12) aged dark vermilion/red enamel steel with small scratches and chips; (13) muted deep indigo-blue painted steel sheets with worn edges and realistic brushed grain; (14) medium-dark graphite-gray perforated industrial metal with very fine evenly-spaced round holes, low contrast; (15) pale cyan-white frosted LED diffuser material, smooth softly mottled flat surface with no scene lighting or bloom.
Palette: subdued atmospheric contemporary cyberpunk, concrete warm beige / pale ivory, structures dark blue-charcoal, teal patina and rust red accent. This is an actual UV sampler resource, not a moodboard or swatch photograph. No text at all.
note: Custom image atlas generated for this project. Signage graphics authored in code. No library assets downloaded.
